C0381.title: Photo Studio Anniversary Recharge Scam Ends in Closure and Flight, Professional Closer Sentenced
C0381.summary: A typical prepaid-consumption case released by the Supreme People's Court disclosed that in February 2023, Zheng Moushun and others took over a photo studio in Haishu District, Ningbo. Although the studio lacked operating conditions, they used an anniversary recharge prize campaign and a false promise to refund the recharge money after the event to induce consumers to pay, then continued inducing on-site recharges at a purported award ceremony. After the event, the defendants closed the shop and disappeared, defrauding consumers of more than 1.46 million yuan. The defendants were sentenced to prison terms and fined for fraud.
